subject.title: PR Limit Update: Why We Now Cap at 20 Open PRs Per Author

question: Should this pinned PR-limit announcement remain open now that CONTRIBUTING.md and Barnacle/Labeler already ship the 20-open-PR cap?
rationale: The source/release implementation is complete, but the issue was intentionally renamed, re-pinned, and reopened after implementation, so closure is an admin/product-policy choice rather than a source cleanup decision.

options.title: Keep Pinned Notice Open
options.body: Leave the issue open and pinned as the visible GitHub policy notice for contributors who hit or question the PR cap.

options.title: Close As Archived Policy Notice
options.body: Close the issue because the policy now lives in shipped docs and automation, while keeping CONTRIBUTING.md as the canonical reference.

options.title: Replace With Maintainer-Owned Notice
options.body: Move the standing notice to another maintainer-owned venue and close this issue after that replacement is visible.

recommendation.title: Keep Pinned Notice Open
recommendation.body: Leave the issue open and pinned as the visible GitHub policy notice for contributors who hit or question the PR cap.

likelyOwner.reason: Takhoffman performed the rename, re-pin, and reopen actions that most directly signal the current policy-notice intent.
